_comment: Synthetic known-role set for the calibration tests (persona: tests/fixtures/workspace). A real workspace keeps its own set in data/calibration.json, built by /hunt-onboard. Score each role with /hunt-triage calibrate, then: node scripts/check-calibration.mjs --file <results.json> [--fixture <set>]. Expectation types: order, tier_at_least, gate_is, reject_on.

roles.title: Head of Engineering (Fractional)
roles.description_text: Fractional Head of Engineering, 15-20 hrs/week, 6-month term. Acme Corp runs a B2B logistics platform built by a team of 12 engineers and an outside agency. Own the architecture, the delivery process and hiring; audit the agency; bring AI-assisted development into the team. Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS. Must have: led engineering teams of 10+; shipped B2B SaaS.
